DOCTOR WHO Season 2 Alternate Ending Featured The Time Lord's Daughter And Granddaughter
========================================================================================

![Image 23: DOCTOR WHO Season 2 Alternate Ending Featured The Time Lord's Daughter And Granddaughter](https://comicbookmovie.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=cover,width=920,quality=75/images/articles/banners/doctor-who-season-2-alternate-ending-featured-the-time-lords-daughter-and-granddaughter-ab224461.jpg)

Carole Ann Ford played the Time Lord's granddaughter in _Doctor Who_, and she's now confirmed that she shot scenes featuring the canonical introduction of the Doctor's daughter. Here's why it was scrapped...
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[News](https://comicbookmovie.com/news/)

**By [JoshWilding](https://comicbookmovie.com/user/JoshWilding)** - Oct 24, 2025 08:10 PM EST

Filed Under: **[Doctor Who](https://comicbookmovie.com/tv/bbc-america/doctor-who/)**

Source: [Cultbox (via SFFGazette.com)](https://sffgazette.com/sci_fi/television/doctor-who-star-confirms-scrapped-alternate-ending-that-would-have-changed-the-entire-franchise-a9319)

In _Doctor Who_'s Season 2 finale, "The Reality War," the Time Lord learned that Fourteen's "bi-generation" was a result of his life force desperately trying to find a way to survive and continue his species.

While setting out to rescue Poppy, his daughter created through a wish, the Doctor poured his own regeneration energy into the Time Vortex, triggering a regeneration. In doing so, he shifted reality so that she could continue to exist as the human daughter of Belinda (which, tragically, meant she was no longer _his_ daughter, as well).

His regeneration did follow, with Ncuti Gatwa's adventurer transforming into a female Doctor with Billie Piper's face. She previously played Rose Tyler in the series and was once exposed to the heart of the TARDIS as "Bad Wolf." That and the fact that she wasn't introduced as the new Doctor has led to speculation that this is a temporary change before the new Doctor is properly introduced.

Much has been said about _Doctor Who_ Season 2 ending with a less definitive regeneration before Piper was cast, or, had one not happened at all, then we'd have gotten a happy ending with the Doctor and his friends gathering at a party (a scene featured in trailers). Gatwa would've continued playing the Time Lord heading into Season 3, but in reality, couldn't remain committed to the show indefinitely when Hollywood is calling.

In a major tease for the future, the Doctor's granddaughter, Susan, was set to be shown from afar alongside Poppy, referring to her as "mum," and confirming that the time-traveller now had a family. Still, with the show's future so uncertain, Russell T Davies decided on a less open-ended conclusion.

Now, actress Carole Ann Ford, who plays the Doctor's granddaughter, [has revealed](https://cultbox.co.uk/general/carole-ann-ford-describes-unused-doctor-who-finale-scene) that she shot these scenes with the intention of further exploring Susan and Poppy's link to the Time Lord down the line.

**_"You didn’t see the episode, which was to sort of introduce my coming back, where I was holding hands with a beautiful little tiny black child \[Sienna-Robyn Mavanga-Phipp\], three years old,"_** she recalled (via [SFFGazette.com](https://sffgazette.com/sci_fi/television/doctor-who-star-confirms-scrapped-alternate-ending-that-would-have-changed-the-entire-franchise-a9319)). **_"And we were watching through the window somewhere where the audience wasn’t supposed to know where we were supposed to be."_**

**_"And we were watching by a newly-embodied grandfather, who was now Ncuti \[Gatwa\], and watching him have a wonderful time singing and dancing in a party in a shop opposite where we were,"_** Ford continued. **_"And obviously, my character Susan, was longing to just go there and fling her arms around her grandfather and say, 'Grandfather, how lovely to see you after all this time and how did you survive your floating about in space...and why have you changed?'"_**

**_"Anyway, that was unfortunately not to be — for reasons I know and will not disclose,"_** she concluded. Davies has instead closed the door on the storytelling potential that the Doctor's daughter and granddaughter have, though the nature of the series means it could somehow be revisited.

Last-minute reshoots completely changed _Doctor Who_'s Season 2 finale, and the fate of the series is no clearer now than it was when this episode aired.

The BBC and Disney+ likely won't announce their plans to part ways until after the spin-off, _The War Between the Land and the Sea_, airs next year. What becomes of _Doctor Who_ from there is hard to say, though another streamer could get involved. Either way, Davies will likely move on ahead of yet another reboot of the long-running sci-fi series.

Doctor Who ‘The Reality War’ cast and runtime announced
=======================================================

Posted  May 21, 2025 by [Andrea Laford](https://cultbox.co.uk/author/andrea-laford) Filed under 
*   [Casting](https://cultbox.co.uk/category/news/casting)
*   [Episodes](https://cultbox.co.uk/category/news/episodes-news)
*   [News](https://cultbox.co.uk/category/news)
*   [Start dates](https://cultbox.co.uk/category/news/start-dates)

The cast and runtime for the eighth _Doctor Who_ Season Two episode _The Reality War_ was revealed on the BBC one Schedule for the programme.

The runtime is 1 hour, 6 minutes.

Tight as a noose, strands that have drawn across seasons and centuries now pull together for a devastating climax. The Doctor is doomed. Belinda is lost. Ruby is trapped. A battle rages across the skies as legends converge. Our brave, battered, beaten Doctor stands alone and helpless as the the Unholy Trinity unleash their deadly ambition and the Underverse rises. The Doctor, Belinda and Ruby must reunite and risk everything in the quest to save one innocent life.

![Image 5: Ncuti Gatwa as the Fifteenth Doctor](https://cultbox.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/Doctor-Who-Lucky-Day-Season-Two-600x337.jpg)

**The Cast:**
-------------

Ncuti Gatwa: **The Doctor**

 Varada Sethu: **Belinda Chandra**

 Millie Gibson: **Ruby Sunday**

 Archie Panjabi: **The Rani**

 Anita Dobson: **Mrs Flood**

 Jonah Hauer-King: **Conrad Clark**

 Sam Lawton: **Winnie Petheridge**

 Ruth Madeley: **Shirley Anne Bingham**

 Michelle Greenidge: **Carla Sunday**

 Sienna-Robyn Mavanga-Phipps: **Poppy**

 Jemma Redgrave: **Kate Lethbridge-Stewart**

 Susan Twist: **Susan Triad**

 Alexander Devrient: **Colonel Christofer Ibrahim**

 Aidan Cook: **The Vlinx**

 Yasmin Finney: **Rose Noble**

 Bonnie Langford: **Melanie Bush**

 Angela Wynter: **Cherry Sunday**

 Faye McKeever: **Louise Miller**

 Nila Aalia: **Lakshmi Chandra**

• Rose Noble, Donna Noble’s daughter, is back

 • Nicholas Briggs, who voices the Vlinx, is not on the cast list

Written by Russell T Davies and directed by Alex Sanjiv Pillai, the _The Reality War_ transmits on Saturday 31 May at 6:50pm on [BBC iPlayer](https://www.bbc.co.uk/iplayer/episodes/p0gglvqn/doctor-who) and on BBC One in the UK. Those outside of the UK can stream _The Reality War_ on Disney+ where available starting at 2pm ET/11am PT, according to the current [Disney+ schedule for May](https://press.disneyplus.com/news/next-on-disney-plus-may-2025).

Directly after the BBC One broadcast, Steffan Powell goes behind the scenes of _The Reality War_ in _Doctor Who: Unleashed_ on BBC Three and on the official YouTube channel where available at 8:00pm.

[![Image 2: Tim taylor ](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/the-human-legion/images/c/cc/Tim_taylor_.jpg/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/180?cb=20150529050315)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/the-human-legion/images/c/cc/Tim_taylor_.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20150529050315)

Tim C. Taylor lives with his family in an old village in England called Bromham. When he was a young and impressionable lad, between 1977 and 1978, several important things happened to him all at once: 2000AD, Star Wars, Blake's 7, and Dungeons & Dragons. Consequently, he now writes science fiction & fantasy.

It wasn't always that way. Before a series of Doctor Who novels inspired him to start writing fiction in 2002, Tim wrote first music and then software. After twenty years in the software industry, Tim took a break in 2011, setting up Greyhart Press, a publisher of science fiction, horror, and fantasy. While most of his time has been spent publishing other authors, Tim found time to complete his first two novels, a series called The Reality War, published February 2012. He started releasing a sister series of military SF novels called The Human Legion during Christmas 2014. They seem to be doing rather well. When no one's looking, he also writes YA fantasy and science fiction short stories under the secret penname of Crustias Scattermush.

In addition to being an up and coming author and literary phenom, Tim finds time to run [Greyhart Press](http://greyhartpress.com/), an electronic publishing house, as the Head Literary Agent and all around Expert of all things Awesome!!!

In the real world, he is husband, Dad, sometime-brewer, and oftentimes-builder of Lego constructs to his son's designs. His favourite beer is Uplift Ale, named in honor of SF author David Brin, and available exclusively from his garage.

==========================================================================

![Image 9: Ncuti Gatwa in a pinstriped suit leaning on a table and staring down the lens in Doctor Who](https://static0.colliderimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/ncuti-gatwa-doctor-who.jpg?&fit=crop&w=1200&h=675)

Image via BBC

[![Image 10: 4](https://static0.colliderimages.com/wordpress%2Fwp-content%2Fauthors%2F672e5041bbbde-Jake-Headshot%20%281%29.jpg?fit=crop&w=90&h=90)](https://collider.com/author/jake-hodges/)

By[Jake Hodges](https://collider.com/author/jake-hodges/)

Published Jun 12, 2025

In over three years at Collider, senior author Jake has now penned over 2500 articles covering a wide range of TV and film for the resources, lists, utilities, news, and interview teams. Alongside interviewing stars such as **[Selin Hizli](https://collider.com/am-i-being-unreasonable-season-2-selin-hizli/)**, [**Rose Ayling-Ellis**](https://collider.com/code-of-silence-trailer/),and [**Chelsea Peretti**](https://collider.com/am-i-being-unreasonable-season-2-chelsea-peretti/), Jake was lucky enough to [**visit the set**](https://collider.com/wallace-and-gromit-vengeance-most-fowl-aardman-set-visit/) of Aardman and Netflix's _**Wallace and Gromit: A Vengeance Most Fowl**_ in 2024, getting the chance to chat with[**four-time Academy Award winner Nick Park**](https://collider.com/chicken-run-oscars/)and**Merlin Crossingham**. Jake has also worked for other publications, including [**Agents of Fandom**](https://agentsoffandom.com/28-years-later-review/).

Plenty of controversy has surrounded [**_Doctor Who_**](https://collider.com/tag/doctor-who/) Season 2, so much so that the timey-wimey series' future is seemingly up in the air. With a frustrating finale providing the pinpoint in a [lackluster Disney era](https://collider.com/doctor-who-disney-seasons/) for the show, many have even suggested that, much like [**Ncuti Gatwa**](https://collider.com/tag/person/ncuti-gatwa/), [**Russell T. Davies**](https://collider.com/tag/russell-t-davies/)' time in charge of _Doctor Who_ should come to an end, with **some even suggesting the series deserves canning altogether.**

One of the headline indicators for those in the latter camp of _Doctor Who_'s failing appeal has been the viewing figures, with [episodes this season](https://collider.com/doctor-who-series-15-episodes-ranked/) dropping lower than ever before. The debate, like the Time War, has raged on, with defenders citing mitigating circumstances such as the rise in streaming and a poorly timed release window. Now, thanks to the official 7-day viewing figures for the finale episode cited via [BARB](https://www.barb.co.uk/viewing-data/most-viewed-programmes/), it seems those arguing for mitigating circumstances may have more than just a point to prove.

[✕ Remove Ads](https://collider.com/premium/?ref=ad_removal)

According to the data, following an overnight viewership of 2.2 million, **"The Reality War" received over 3.4 million viewers in the UK when including streaming figures**. This is a steep incline from previous outings in the season, and points to the [season's propensity to promise huge twists](https://collider.com/doctor-who-season-15-billie-piper-ncuti-gatwa/) as working at least statistically. Compared to the episode prior, "Wish World," viewership figures were up almost 500,000, helping _Doctor Who_ become the second-most-watched non-soap opera drama on the BBC for that week. What certainly helped the episode's cause was the choice not to release it on streaming until it coincided with the live broadcast, something the rest of the season had not adhered to which likely severely damaged its overnight viewing figures.

Is 'Doctor Who' Here to Stay?
-----------------------------

[✕ Remove Ads](https://collider.com/premium/?ref=ad_removal)

With an exciting spin-off on the way and news that _Doctor Who_ is taking to children's television in the UK once again, it seems the **BBC at least want their headline sci-fi series to stay.**Alongside strong viewership figures for the finale, which saw almost 3.5 million people in the UK alone watch as Gatwa regenerated into [**Billie Piper**](https://collider.com/tag/billie-piper/), the final episode was also released into select UK cinemas, with venues across the country selling out in quick time. The hunger for more _Doctor Who_ is alive and well, but the same desire for Davies' era in particular to continue is questionable at best.

After That Shocking Doctor Who Return, We Want This Other Star to Come Back After 15 Years
==========================================================================================

By [Kai Young](https://comicbook.com/author/kai-young/ "Posts by Kai Young")

June 6, 2025, 2:20pm

[Comments 2](https://comicbook.com/tv-shows/news/doctor-who-season-series-16-jackie-tyler-return-theory-billie-piper/#comments)

*   [Click to share on X (Opens in new window)X](https://comicbook.com/tv-shows/news/doctor-who-season-series-16-jackie-tyler-return-theory-billie-piper/?share=x&nb=1)
*   [Click to share on Facebook (Opens in new window)Facebook](https://comicbook.com/tv-shows/news/doctor-who-season-series-16-jackie-tyler-return-theory-billie-piper/?share=facebook&nb=1)

Billie Piper has officially returned to _[Doctor Who](https://comicbook.com/tag/doctor-who/)_ after 12 years, and while her return has caused some confusion, this could open the door for another star to reprise her role. _Doctor Who_ series 15’s finale, “The Reality War,” marked the dramatic ending of Ncuti Gatwa’s run as the 15th Doctor. He gave up his current incarnation to bring Belinda Chandra’s (Varada Sethu) daughter, Poppy, back to life, leading to his regeneration, but this was no typical passing of the baton from actor to actor, as it was [_Doctor Who_ veteran Billie Piper](https://comicbook.com/tv-shows/news/doctor-who-billie-piper-return-comments/) who replaced Gatwa.

Videos by ComicBook.com
-----------------------

[“The Reality War’s” credits sequence](https://comicbook.com/tv-shows/news/doctor-who-season-15-ncuti-gatwa-exit-explained/) did not credit Billie Piper as the new Doctor, which has spurred speculation that she’ll be playing someone entirely different. Piper previously appeared in _Doctor Who_ as Rose Tyler, the companion to Christopher Eccleston and David Tennant’s Doctors in 2005 and 2006, and she also made cameo appearances in 2008 and 2010. If Piper is returning to _Doctor Who_ as some version of Rose Tyler — thanks to Russell T. Davis’ timey-wimey stuff — the opportunity may be created for even more actors from _Doctor Who_ history to return, and one is particularly exciting.

Billie Piper’s Appearance Makes Jackie Tyler’s _Doctor Who_ Return More Likely
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

![Image 6: Woman with blonde hair, styled in a ponytail with bangs, looking upwards with a contemplative expression](https://comicbook.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2025/06/Jackie-Tyler-in-Doctor-Who-series-2s-finale.jpg?w=1024)
Aside from her appearance as the sentient weapon, the Moment, in 2013’s “The Day of the Doctor,” the series’ 50th anniversary special, Billie Piper last appeared in Doctor Who as Rose Tyler in 2010. This was in a brief scene bidding farewell to David Tennant’s 10th Doctor, in which Rose appeared with her mother, Camille Coduri’s Jackie Tyler, on New Year’s Day, 2005. Jackie Tyler was an ever-present supporting character in Rose’s narrative, so Piper’s return to the series could also signal Coduri reprising her fan-favorite role.

Best known for roles in _Him & Her, King Ralph, Big Boys_, and more, Camille Coduri is a fantastic comedy actor who was an inspired casting choice for Rose Tyler’s mother in _Doctor Who_. Despite returning as showrunner in 2023, Russell T. Davies hasn’t really paid too much homage to his previous run on the show, which is widely considered to be the strongest era of the show since its revival. Bringing back Billie Piper has changed this, so it would be great to see Camille Coduri return to reunite with her on-screen daughter.

#### RELATED: [Christopher Eccleston, Billie Piper Reunite for New Doctor Who Adventures (and There’s Already a Teaser Trailer)](https://comicbook.com/tv-shows/news/christopher-eccleston-billie-piper-reunite-new-doctor-who-adventures/)

Prior to her brief cameo in 2010’s “The End of Time,” Jackie Tyler previously appeared alongside Rose in 2008’s series 4 double-finale, “The Stolen Earth” and “Journey’s End.” This caught up with the Tyler family on their alternate world, Pete’s World, where they all became trapped after the emotional and intense series 2 finale, “Doomsday.” Piper hasn’t yet been confirmed to be returning as Rose Tyler, and she may, indeed, be the official 16th Doctor, but, either way, it would make sense for Jackie Tyler to be paid a visit.

Why Jackie Tyler’s _Doctor Who_ Return Would Make Sense, Even If Billie Piper Isn’t Rose
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

![Image 7: Three characters from Doctor Who – Jackie Tyler, Rose Tyler, and The Doctor – stand on a beach, looking to the right of the frame with worried expressions on their faces](https://comicbook.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2025/06/Jackie-Tyler-Rose-Tyler-and-the-Doctor-in-Doctor-Who-series-4s-finale.jpg?w=1024)
There are many possible explanations for [Billie Piper’s return to _Doctor Who_](https://comicbook.com/tv-shows/news/doctor-who-regeneration-ncuti-gatwa-billie-piper/) after 12 years, and each of them would leave the door open for Camille Coduri to also reappear as Jackie Tyler. If Piper is portraying the 16th Doctor, which has been disputed, she would remember Jackie as a friend and perhaps track her down to discuss the weird face-change. Over the course of two seasons, Jackie became a close ally to the Doctor, and she even experienced his regeneration, so this could create a fantastic and funny moment featuring Piper and Coduri.

Play video![Image 8: Play](https://img.youtube.com/vi/XgLpmL9p3Go/hqdefault.jpg)

Alternately, Piper could have returned as a version of Rose Tyler, somehow replacing the Doctor during his regeneration. If this is the case, there’s no doubt she’d want to find her mother, perhaps seeking guidance or aid, though it’s unclear how she would cross the universal boundaries again. It’s also possible that Piper is returning to _Doctor Who_ as someone completely different, perhaps someone we haven’t met before, and even this would constitute an appearance of Coduri’s Jackie Tyler, as she would surely have some chosen words to say about a new character assuming the likeness of her daughter.

[_Doctor Who_ hasn’t yet been confirmed to be coming back](https://comicbook.com/tv-shows/news/doctor-who-canceled-rumors-of-ncuti-gatwas-exit-swirl-as-ratings-nosedive/) after series 15’s finale, it’s the longest-running sci-fi series of all time, so it would be a mistake for it to disappear. This is especially true now that the monumental mystery of Billie Piper’s return has been created, as there is a great need for this unsolved ending to be addressed. Whether Billie Piper is back as Rose, the Moment, the Doctor, or someone else, it would be incredible to hear Jackie Tyler’s thoughts on this reintroduction, so we hope Camille Coduri comes back to _Doctor Who_, too.

Which characters from Russell T. Davies’ original run on _Doctor Who_ do you want to see return? Let us know in the comments!

RRS Roundup: Reality War 2
==========================

[August 6, 2012August 11, 2012](https://davidmarkbrownwrites.com/rrs-roundup-reality-war-2/ "8:00 am") by [David Mark Brown](https://davidmarkbrownwrites.com/author/hache/ "View all posts by David Mark Brown")

This week on **Read it! Review it! Share it!** I’m addressing the first noteworthy sequel to find its way onto the Green Porch. And it’s a grand adventure.

[The Reality War Book2: The City of Destruction](http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B008JFMKT2/ref=as_li_ss_tl?ie=UTF8&tag=davmarbro-20&linkCode=as2&camp=1789&creative=390957&creativeASIN=B008JFMKT2)![Image 1](http://www.assoc-amazon.com/e/ir?t=davmarbro-20&l=as2&o=1&a=B008JFMKT2)

![Image 2: Reality War 2](http://davidmarkbrownwrites.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/08/realitywar2.jpg)I’ve also reviewed the [first book in this series](http://davidmarkbrownwrites.com/rrs-roundup-lizard-brains-and-terminal-viscosity/ "RRS Roundup: Lizard Brains and Terminal Viscosity") and highly recommend reading it before the second. Rather than being separate entities, they are parts of the same whole. That being said, _The City of Destruction_ is as toothsome as it is brainsome. It is a mind-altering twisty tale not without a devastatingly-human element.

Two opposing forces, intelligent races, duel across time and space to win a war that dictates whether they ever even existed. History will remember only the winner, but does that make them righteous? or merely victorious?

In a story where some sacrifices last forever and others never happened (or sometimes both at once) the main players develop complex motives and even more complex complexes in a manner that kept me thinking about the repercussions of human relationship.

I love time travel when it’s done right. _The City of Destruction_ was just that, sporting a host of character-testing contradictions that beg readers to inspect their deepest selves. If right and wrong were irrelevant would I abandon my humanity to do what had to be done to save it? **Read it! Review it! Share it!**
